data.name: Destroy the Flag
data.detailed_description:
BLOW UP FLAGS

Destroy the Flag is a fast, chaotic online multiplayer game where teams (or lone wolves) fight to demolish each other's flag before their own goes down. Nobody has HP — bombs don't kill, they launch you into orbit, freeze you solid, or send you flying off the map.

THE ARSENAL

- Bomb — the only explosive that actually damages flags. Basic, reliable, always in your pocket.

- Knockback Bomb — devastating knockback. Drop one under your own feet for a rocket jump across the map.

- Freezing Bomb — freeze nearby enemies solid for a few precious seconds. Pick it up on the field.

- Haste Bomb — a team-wide (okay, everyone-wide) buff: triple speed and a knockback boost for 30 seconds.

More bomb types are planned in future updates, so the arsenal keeps growing.

THREE PHASES, ONE ESCALATING FIGHT

Round one is a no-flag-damage skirmish for grabbing field items. Phase two opens the flags up to attack. Phase three removes the clock entirely and doubles flag damage — no more stalling, someone's flag is going down.

CHAOS MODE

Flip it on and brace yourself: giant meteors slam into the map with a screen-shaking impact, dodgeballs and basketballs rain down and bounce off everything (including you), rogue ice cubes skate around freezing anyone they touch, and thrown knives fly at the nearest player. All fully random, all fully optional chaos.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Solo free-for-all or team battles — up to 4 teams, up to 32 players. Pick a flag HP preset, pick your map, pick your chaos level, and go. Jump in with simple WASD + mouse controls — no complicated combos, just grab a bomb and go.
